question: On English audio, does Pipecat Smart Turn v3.2 or p99lab turn-1-mini hold a pre-registered operating point (false cutoff <= 10% AND missed END <= 10%), and at what endpointing wait?

protocol.policySemantics: hold_model_fire = max(actionDelay, holdFire); cutoff = (fired & holdDur > max(actionDelay,fire)) | holdDur > timeout; detect = eotFired & eotFire <= timeout; eotLatency = detect ? fire : timeout
protocol.fireTest: p_eot >= threshold (protocol.mts spanFire); eot-bench uses strict `>` — the >= choice is inherited from the shared P0.7/P0.11 scorer and recorded here as a deliberate, uniform deviation
protocol.holdDenominator: eot spans always; holds only in [0.2, 5] s (eot-bench metrics.py)
protocol.causalGridMaxSilence: unbounded (eot-bench walks the whole span; protocol.mts defaults to 1.5 s, overridden here)
protocol.degenerateThreshold: threshold 0 is dropped from the DECISION set (p_eot >= 0 fires at every cell) — AC5
protocol.turn1miniSlice: frame j ends at sample (j+1)*320; a cell whose prefix ends at E reads frame floor(E/320)-1
protocol.cellCut: E = floor(timestampMs * sampleRate / 1000) — exact in float64, matching eot-bench floor((start+d)*sr); the manifest start carries ms rounding (<0.5 ms, sub-frame)
protocol.smartTurnWindow: predictEndpoint rule: last 8 s, front-padded with zeros when the prefix is shorter
